statement.note: 预案表（幂等 IF NOT EXISTS）。id 由 sequence 发号禁 AUTO_INCREMENT（D2）；preset_name uk=按名幂等 upsert 锚

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {presetTable} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（starsite-sequence 组件生成）', preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '预案名（repayday/daily/batch-window）', core_size INT NOT NULL COMMENT '核心线程数', max_size INT NOT NULL COMMENT '最大线程数', keep_alive_seconds INT NOT NULL COMMENT '空闲保活秒', queue_capacity INT NULL COMMENT '队列容量（null=不管理队列容量；V2 可变容量队列）', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_tuner_preset_name (preset_name) COMMENT '按名幂等 upsert 锚' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='线程池参数预案'

statement.note: 窗口表（幂等）：pool_name+start/end cron 对；命中判定=纯时间函数（nextAfter 比较），多实例各自求值收敛

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {windowTable} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（starsite-sequence 组件生成）', pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '受管池名', preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '窗口内应用的预案名', start_cron VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '窗口开始 cron（6 字段）', end_cron VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '窗口结束 cron', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_tw_pool (pool_name) COMMENT '按池查窗口' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='参数窗口（预案按时段生效）'

statement.note: 绑定表（幂等）：池默认预案（无窗口命中时应用）；pool_name uk

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {bindingTable} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（starsite-sequence 组件生成）', pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '受管池名', preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '默认预案名', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_tb_pool (pool_name) COMMENT '按池幂等 upsert 锚' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='池默认预案绑定'

statement.note: 审计表（幂等）：per-host 实际变更留痕（合规要求——谁/何时/旧到新/触发源）；host+pool+time 组合查询锚

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {auditTable} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（starsite-sequence 组件生成）', occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '变更时刻', host VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '实例 hostname:pid（per-host 真实账面变化）', pool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '受管池名', preset_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '生效预案名', source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT '触发源 SCHEDULE/MANUAL/STARTUP', old_core INT NOT NULL COMMENT '旧核心数', old_max INT NOT NULL COMMENT '旧最大数', old_keep INT NOT NULL COMMENT '旧保活秒', new_core INT NOT NULL COMMENT '新核心数', new_max INT NOT NULL COMMENT '新最大数', new_keep INT NOT NULL COMMENT '新保活秒', old_queue INT NULL COMMENT '旧队列容量（null=不涉及；V2）', new_queue INT NULL COMMENT '新队列容量（null=不涉及；V2）', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_ta_pool_time (pool_name, occurred_at) COMMENT '按池查变更史' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='参数变更审计'

statement.note: 按名幂等 upsert（uk 冲突转更新——治理面重复提交安全）

dialect.statement: INSERT INTO {presetTable} (id, preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity, gmt_create) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE core_size = VALUES(core_size), max_size = VALUES(max_size), keep_alive_seconds = VALUES(keep_alive_seconds), queue_capacity = VALUES(queue_capacity)
SELECT preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity FROM {presetTable} WHERE preset_name = ?
SELECT preset_name, core_size, max_size, keep_alive_seconds, queue_capacity FROM {presetTable} ORDER BY preset_name

statement.note: 按池幂等 upsert 默认预案绑定

dialect.statement: INSERT INTO {bindingTable} (id, pool_name, preset_name, gmt_create) VALUES (?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preset_name = VALUES(preset_name)

statement.note: 绑定计数（健康端点——治理面全局可见）

dialect.statement: INSERT INTO {windowTable} (id, pool_name, preset_name, start_cron, end_cron, gmt_create) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

statement.note: 窗口清单（pool 为 null 查全部）——动态过滤用白名单方法而非拼接（D5）

dialect.statement: SELECT id, pool_name, preset_name, start_cron, end_cron FROM {windowTable} WHERE (? IS NULL OR pool_name = ?) ORDER BY pool_name, id

INSERT INTO {auditTable} (id, occurred_at, host, pool_name, preset_name, source, old_core, old_max, old_keep, new_core, new_max, new_keep, old_queue, new_queue, gmt_create) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

statement.note: 最近审计（新→旧；occurred_at 倒序）

dialect.statement: SELECT id, occurred_at, host, pool_name, preset_name, source, old_core, old_max, old_keep, new_core, new_max, new_keep, old_queue, new_queue FROM {auditTable} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?

statement.note: 配置版本戳（三表 gmt_modified 最大值——轮询短路依据，写后必变）

dialect.statement: SELECT GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM {presetTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM {windowTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM {bindingTable}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(gmt_modified) FROM {auditTable}), '1970-01-01') ) AS stamp

statement.note: 审计 retention 第一步：圈到期行主键（occurred_at 命中 idx_ta_pool_time 退化扫描可接受——低频卫生任务；两步法分片红线合规）

dialect.statement: SELECT id FROM {auditTable} WHERE occurred_at < ? LIMIT ?

statement.note: 审计 retention 第二步：按主键集合删除（{idPlaceholders} 由存储层按选中条数渲染——占位符非值）
